name: io.github.VitalyTolstik/janosik
description: Drive a Janosik Kanban board from any MCP client: cards, leases, task specs and agent activity.

environmentVariables.name: JANOSIK_URL
environmentVariables.description: Origin of your Janosik instance, e.g. https://boards.example.com

environmentVariables.name: JANOSIK_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Personal API key (jnk_…), created in Account → API keys

environmentVariables.name: JANOSIK_APP_BASE
environmentVariables.description: App sub-path, only when the app is not served at the site root (e.g. /app)
